procedural_matters: AUT 8577 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
facts: AUT tacked on to starboard at the mark.
GER had to luff above a close-hauled course to avoid AUT
conclusions: AUT 8577 caused GER 8581, who was on starboard tack since entering the zone, to sail above close-hauled to avoid contact. AUT 8577 broke RRS 18.3(a).
